doc: Cycles from the end of an MMA op's pipe occupancy to its result being readable (accumulator handoff on Hopper; zero on Blackwell where the commit delay is blackwell.umma.commit). Measurement scope (both devices): the pipe beat and completion are measured with accumulating same-D operations (wgmma / tcgen05.mma chains that accumulate into one D); input-D-disabled and independently pipelined D variants are not measured separately and are modelled with the same values (formerly the b300 source experimental.umma.accumulating_scope).
